verdict.rationale: Carta documents OAuth 2.0 with a CLIENT_CREDENTIALS grant for machine access, OAuth scopes that can be added to an application, and service-account-style applications attached to an Investment Firm. Together these are first-party credential issuance with scopes, but the evidence only shows scopes being added to expand capabilities, not least-privilege restriction. missing for 10: evidence of granular or read-only scope selection for least privilege, guidance on issuing per-agent credentials, credential rotation/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
